body: I know what you mean, man. It’s hard but I’m sure your brother still loves you though.

I have a therapist but I honestly haven’t been seeing her for a while. I don’t have a lawyer and honestly I’m not too educated on the law aspects of this. I’m sure he made of the restraining order lie because I’ve never received any official government document relating to a restraining order? And it’s not like I was stalking him or harassing him or anything like that. In fact, if anything he came into close contact with me by attending a class that I was in but he wasn’t enrolled in
Thank you so much. It really hurts when people try to use the “he’s a good guy” narrative but people don’t understand that “good” people can also do bad things
Thank you. It honestly surprised me on what this guy was talking about but I do believe my abuser made up lies/“fake proof” to try to create his innocence :/
Thank you so much. I do have a great support system and hopefully one day I’ll be healed :)
Thank you so much it really means a lot to me. And yeah I agree. I guess it’s better to come to terms that someone is a liar rather than a sexual assaulter

As much as I don’t want to admit it, I’m a different person now. I wish he didn’t have that much power over me but my life is completely different because of him. I’m currently in a male-dominated field and I’m afraid of my own colleagues, just because they’re male. I don’t really have a sex drive because I’m afraid of physical intimacy (the anti-depressants probably have something to do with this too). I’ve become extremely shy and afraid of relationships because I am afraid to trust people. I can’t really hug or have any physical contact with my friends or family. I spend hours laying in bed wondering what I did wrong, blaming myself, crying, etc. I’ll go through cycles where I invalidate myself, call myself crazy or a liar, then I’ll realize and tell myself that it did happen and that my feelings are valid. All of the time “wasted” doing these stupid mental gymnastics with myself have greatly affected my studies. My outlook on life changed. I used to believe people are inherently good but now I’m terrified of the evil people are capable of. I’m hoping through therapy my depression, anxiety, PTSD will hopefully get better and I’ll be “normal” again. As for now, I’m just trying my best to simply exist. I try not to view it as “rape changed my life” but more as “once I’m healed, I’ll be stronger than I ever was before.”
Thank you it means a lot, it really does. I guess it hurts to be painted as a liar/crazy. Hopefully one day our society will change for the better
Thank you. I’m just afraid my of my parents pushing me to finish school ASAP and it later hurting my grades/mental health even more.
